_readme: Settings for 'Grandpa's Cards' (كروت جدو), the memory game at Alexandria & the sea. Change numbers here; no code change needed. cardCounts: the levels (number of cards; each letter's capital + small make a pair, so 64 = all 32 letters). phoneMaxCards: phones (shortest screen side under smallScreenWidth) don't offer bigger levels, the cards would be too small. smallScreenWidth: below this shortest side (logical pixels) the brothers are hidden and only peek in to flip a card. heroRunMs: how long the brother takes to reach a card (the card flips when he gets there). mismatchShowMs: how long two different cards stay up before turning back. nameBubbleMs: how long the letter's name stays in the bubble after a flip. soundless: Level 2 (letter + sound cards) — what the sound card shows for a letter with no sounds in letters.json, by letter id. art.background / art.cardBack: pictures (see design/game-prompts.md); without them both are drawn in code.
